requirements.text: Active `OUT`/`SUB` counts stay non-increasing whenever no growth authorization is in the log
Retirement uses the unchanged `~~OUT-n~~ retired: <why>` / `~~SUB-n~~ retired: <why>` form
Ids are never renumbered (pre-existing rule, unchanged by this diff)
A reword/retire revision returning `Scope changed: yes` still re-dispatches the decomposer as today, and raises no growth finding (no id is new)
A finding / `## Open questions` entry / deferred Phase-3 `Flags:` choice needing a new id routes to `user` and is asked as the two-option gate, with the choice recorded in the review log
Exactly one growth revision may add ids per recorded authorization, bounded to the authorized gap and count

The host's post-revision id-diff check runs immediately after *every* revision (both a rule-1 integration dispatch and a rule-4 blocking-findings dispatch) and before the next Phase 4 review, catching unauthorized growth regardless of `Scope changed:`
A rule-1 user answer whose integration needs a new id is itself auto-recorded as the growth authorization, with no separate gate, and `Revisions used` increments once
A headless run needing growth (a `[growth]`-tagged `route: user` item reaching Phase 5 rule 1) ends `CHARTER — Needs input`; it never hangs

Writer revision-mode contract: fix/reword/retire freely; no new `OUT-n` id without a stated growth authorization; gap recorded under the existing `## Open questions` section; no new output-block field
Decomposer revision-mode contract: same, reported via `Flags: [growth] <one line>`; no new output-block field (a new value within the existing enum)

Reviewer checklist: a finding needing a new outcome/sub-task (including a round ≥2 reviewer meeting a charter `## Open questions` entry) routes `user`; explicitly a routing rule only, never a growth detector
Phase 3: a revision-mode decomposer `[growth]`-tagged `Flags:` choice defers to the Phase 5 growth gate; every other choice (including an irreducible size overrun) keeps the immediate Phase 3 ask
No new writer/decomposer output-block fields introduced
The host records active `OUT`/`SUB` counts per round in the review log

Roles keep their boundaries — growth-authorization and active-count records live only in `03_review-log.md` (already host-owned outright); the host never edits `01_charter.md`/`02_subtasks.md` beyond the pre-existing permitted metadata lines
Core stays domain-free
`SKILL.md` ends no higher than its line count at the start of the slice
Version bump: PATCH
Touched files match exactly the constraint's list
`references/convergence-loop.md`'s reserved `### SUB-2` section is filled with the slice's rationale
The reqs' own "Verification evidence" — a replay of C031's final artifacts under the new contracts, and a first live run — showing non-increasing counts absent a logged authorization
